title: Priest tells Vallee to burn an IBM circuit card as 'from the Devil'

tellings.quote: and he looked at it and he said my son burn it it is from the Devil

plain: In France, sometime in the 1950s or 60s, a priest looked at an IBM computer circuit card and told the researcher Jacques Vallée, "my son burn it, it is from the Devil." Vallée tells Michels this as something that happened to him, and he mentions a person named Michelle in telling it. The story shows how strange and threatening early computer hardware could look to a churchman of that time.
